Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.

怎么写视频提示词

截图发给豆包同时发送以下的提示词

这张图为首帧图的视频提示词，7秒时间，主要展现(这个你描述个大概)。一个要求，就是什么时间秒做什么内容，不用一秒一秒来，按照内容动作来规划。给我现在这张图的英文视频提示词，要英文提示词，一整段不分段

pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly,subtitles, caption, captions, closed captions, CC, on-screen text, text overlay, words, letters, characters, readable text, typography, subtitles bar, karaoke lyrics, lyric video, lower third, title card, UI, HUD, watermark, logo, signature, timestamp, sticker, banner, scrolling text, low quality, lowres, blurry, flicker, jitter, shaky camera, ghosting, frame doubling, temporal inconsistency, face warp, face melt, asymmetrical eyes, bad teeth, extra teeth, tongue artifact, mouth deformation, lip-sync mismatch, over-smoothing, plastic skin, heavy beauty filter, harsh sharpening, banding, noise, extra fingers, extra hands，Finger Twisting，Subtitles。
音频最长建议大概20多s左右，你也可以尝试30s以内，

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2.3 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)
